title: A Counterexample to Wall's D(2) Problem

abstractEnglish: We give a negative answer to Wall's finite $`D(2)`$ problem. We construct a finite connected three-dimensional CW complex satisfying the $`D(2)`$ finiteness condition but not homotopy equivalent to any finite CW complex of dimension at most two. The example has infinite fundamental group.
